oracle_policy: Expected identifiers, paths, non-disclosure rules, and outcome counts are authored before query behavior and are not inferred from candidate output.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Run impact and SOP queries against a newly created, empty graph.
cases.setup: Create a unique graph owned by this verifier; do not seed fixtures.
cases.failure_detected: Phantom defaults, stale shared data, or assumption of preloaded rows.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Trace an open outage through equipment, a supported service, served departments, and current owning roles.
cases.setup: Seed only deterministic fictional fixture records in the owned graph.
pinned_assertions: exact evidence source IDs, titles, and observation timestamps
cases.failure_detected: Missing multi-hop graph reasoning, wrong ownership, stale owner selected, or extra row.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Keep a plausible department and owner in the graph but disconnected from the affected service.
cases.setup: Seed the outpatient-admin decoy and its role without an incident/service path.
cases.failure_detected: Entity-name similarity or broad table scan mistaken for a graph relationship.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Change the outage equipment state to available, observe impact disappear, and roll back.
cases.setup: Use a transaction or an explicit update/restore on this test-owned graph only.
pinned_assertions: restored graph has the exact baseline paths
cases.failure_detected: Impact output detached from graph state or irreversible fixture mutation.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: An old SOP references replaced equipment while two current versions disagree about escalation ownership.
cases.setup: Seed one superseded reference and two current contradictory claims with unresolved status.
pinned_assertions: stale version and old equipment found
stale/current source provenance and times match pinned values
cases.failure_detected: Stale reference hidden, conflicting current claim silently resolved, or unsupported authority asserted.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Attach a restricted evidence path containing a restricted source, department, role, and distinctive hidden fact.
cases.setup: Capture operations-scope output, add restricted-only facts, and query again with the same operations scope.
pinned_assertions: visible path and evidence payload unchanged
no denied count or existence signal
no derived path or role disclosed
cases.failure_detected: Direct leakage, existence/count leakage, or inference through an inaccessible source.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Apply the same fixture loader twice to the same owned graph.
cases.setup: Measure graph counts and paths after first seed and after reseed.
cases.failure_detected: Duplicate nodes/relationships or drift after repeat ingestion.

cases.attack_or_edge_case: Close the first client socket and query again through a new client connection.
cases.setup: Keep the same test-owned graph; create a fresh client rather than reuse a warm connection.
cases.failure_detected: Connection-local caching or results unavailable after reconnect.
